get.description:
Show the installed version's changelog as Markdown, or with `--newer` what newer releases bring.

Only `--newer` uses the network: GETs to the GitHub releases API of the repository in the uv tool receipt (or the
default repository) with a `heinzel/<version>` User-Agent (ADR 0031), a few pages at most, and the GitHub token
of the settings (GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN) if one is set; unauthenticated otherwise.

Raises:
    HeinzelError: If the changelog is not part of this installation, or, with `--newer`, GitHub can't be asked.

parameters.description: Show what the releases newer than the installed version bring instead, newest first; asks GitHub, with GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN if set. As JSON: a list of {version, date, notes, url}.
parameters.name: newer

schema.description: Show what the releases newer than the installed version bring instead, newest first; asks GitHub, with GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN if set. As JSON: a list of {version, date, notes, url}.
schema.title: Newer

get.summary: Show the installed version's changelog as Markdown, or with `--newer` what newer releases bring.

get.description:
Find plugins to install: first-party ones, and community ones by querying the GitHub API.

Community plugins are GitHub repositories with the topic heinzel-plugin; GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN raises the rate
limit. Offline, only first-party plugins are listed. PyPI has no keyword search, so it is not queried. Community
plugins are not reviewed by the Heinzelmännchen maintainers, and every plugin runs with your rights.

get.description:
Ask where Heinzelmännchen was installed from for its latest release, and whether to update.

One unauthenticated GET to the GitHub releases API of the repository in the uv tool receipt (or the default
repository) with only a `heinzel/<version>` User-Agent (ADR 0031); offline or rate-limited, the result carries a
warning. Always asks, even when the hourly check (setting `update_check`) asked a minute ago; the answer is
cached for the update notice.
get.summary: Ask where Heinzelmännchen was installed from for its latest release, and whether to update.
